featuresSection.subtitle: One platform to design your floor plan, manage bookings, and understand your guests.

items.title: Visual floor plan builder
items.description: Drag-and-drop tables, shapes, and multiple floors to mirror your real dining room layout in minutes.

items.title: Smart reservations calendar
items.description: Diagram, Day, Week, and Timeline views keep every booking, table, and party size in perfect sync.

items.title: Customer relationship hub
items.description: Track visit history, tags, and status for every guest so your team can deliver a personal touch.

items.title: Actionable analytics
items.description: Spot peak hours, no-show trends, and table utilization at a glance with built-in reporting.
